propositions: Seven plan-review recommendations (R1-R7) derived from task-decomposition SOTA research must be validated experimentally (E1-E6 gates) before implementation, with each recommendation gated by its own falsifiable acceptance threshold drawn from the report's experiment table.

R1/R3/R4 ship in advisory (non-blocking) posture first, pass a bounded sanity check, and are auto-monitored by standing dogfood effectiveness recorder (d8a5) instead of pre-ship batch evals; advisory→blocking promotion is gated on accumulated dogfood evidence.

E2/E3 batch-eval gates were permanently rejected on cost grounds and superseded by d8a5's zero-LLM standing effectiveness recorder (criterion_effectiveness.py); E1's finding-adjudication/inter-rater-kappa corpus was invalidated (tool-less/plan-truncated labeling ~79% contaminated) and descoped.

R2/R3/R4 each touch criteria_routing.json and must land serially (file-impact prevents batching); R5's IMPACT_MODEL_VERSION bump is coordinated with floor-split story to avoid double-bumps; R6 ships deterministic (no eval gate) with validator compliance, validated by R7 dogfooding.

R7 instrumentation provides standing dogfood monitoring; a criterion's blocking-FP proxy (fraction of blocking findings subsequently adjudicated false-positive over a trailing window) exceeding 10% triggers demotion to advisory via criteria_routing.json change.

Implementation changes land directly in packaged registry (no config-flag or overlay gating); the advisory-first + standing-dogfood strategy with documented promotion gates replaces the original batch-eval-gated plan per operator-approved cost decision.
